facts.fact: 被抱＝无助者的待遇——母亲从不许她显得无助，所以她从没被抱过。
facts.anchor: Being carried was for the helpless.

facts.fact: 不必她说：他全知道她想要什么、需要什么。
facts.anchor: He knew, he knew exactly what I wanted.

facts.fact: 她一生都由别人决定她属于哪里、能做什么。
facts.anchor: My entire life, people had decided where I belonged.

facts.fact: 狼眼给她的三样：边缘、距离、细节。
facts.anchor: This is what my wolf gave me. Edges. Distance. Detail.

facts.fact: 每一次逃脱都让她更想被抓。
facts.anchor: Every escape made me want the capture more.

facts.fact: 核心确认：无论她跑多远，他都会来。
facts.anchor: He would always come for me.

facts.fact: 最重的一句：他不是被迫娶她、没把娇妻当负担——他选择了她。
他的誓言：无论你跑多远、多黑，我都会追来。
facts.anchor: I will always come for you.
